description: Fabric mod for Minecraft 26.3 that fixes MC-311424: with an IME, Right Shift triggers every unbound key binding

mods.name: IME-Shift-Fix
mods.description: Fixes MC-311424: with an IME, Right Shift no longer triggers every key binding set to Not Bound, and key bindings set to Right Shift work.

releases.notes:
Minecraft Java Edition 26.3 の [MC-311424](https://mojira.dev/MC-311424) を直します。
Fixes [MC-311424](https://mojira.dev/MC-311424) in Minecraft Java Edition 26.3.

- IME を使っているときに右Shift を押しても、未割り当ての操作が動かなくなります。右Shift に割り当てた操作は動きます。
- With an IME, Right Shift no longer triggers key bindings set to Not Bound, and key bindings set to Right Shift work.

必要なもの / Requirements: Minecraft 26.3 (26.3.x), Fabric Loader 0.19.5+（Fabric API は不要 / Fabric API is not required）
